issues.title: Off-by-one error in scroll index calculation
issues.description: The scroll position calculation uses `state.tabs.count` instead of `state.tabs.count - 1` when scrolling to the last tab. Since array indices are zero-based, accessing index equal to the count will cause an index out-of-bounds crash. This occurs when switching between normal and private tab panels when there's no selected tab, causing the app to attempt scrolling to a non-existent tab position. The original code correctly used `count - 1` to get the last valid index before the inactive tabs feature was removed.

issues.title: Incorrect section index after inactive tabs removal
issues.description: The scrollToTab method hardcodes section index as 1, which was correct when there were two sections (inactive tabs at section 0 and regular tabs at section 1). After removing inactive tabs, there is only one section (section 0), so this will cause scroll operations to fail or crash when trying to access a non-existent section. This affects all scroll-to-tab functionality including selecting tabs, undoing tab closures, and panel switching. The TabDisplayDiffableDataSource now only creates a single section `.tabs`, but this scroll method wasn't updated accordingly.

issues.title: Nested struct added without explicit access control modifier
issues.description: The newly added nested type `v147` is declared as `struct v147` without an explicit access control modifier (e.g., `public`/`internal`/`private`). Rule 11 requires explicit access control on declarations based on intended scope. Many other nested structs in this file use `public struct ...`, so this is an inconsistency and a clear violation in the added code.
issues.rule_name: Rule 11: Properties and Methods Must Have Appropriate Access Control

pr.title: Code Review Bench PR #31168 - Remove FXIOS-14327 [Clean up] Inactive tabs removal part 2 (final)
pr.author: unknown

structured_output.summary:
This PR finishes removing the Inactive Tabs feature from the tab tray. It deletes the InactiveTabsModel, InactiveTabsSectionManager, and the three InactiveTabs cell/header/footer views, removes the inactive-tab actions, reducer branches, middleware helpers and toast types, and drops the `inactiveTabs`/`isInactiveTabsExpanded` state. The Xcode project file, accessibility identifiers, and XCUI test indices are updated to match, and the tests are trimmed accordingly. The bulk of the deletion is mechanically consistent, and the pbxproj edits remove every reference to the deleted files.

Three real problems block the merge. First, `createTabScrollBehavior` changed the "no selected tab" fallback from `tabs.count - 1` to `tabs.count`, which is an out-of-bounds index, so scrolling can produce an invalid IndexPath and crash. The existing unit test still expects `tabCount - 1`, so the change would fail CI. Second, `TabTrayStateTests.swift` still calls `.refreshInactiveTabs`, a case this PR deletes, so the ClientTests target will not compile. Third, the MPL license header was stripped from `TabPanelAction.swift`, which breaks the repo's license convention. Smaller issues include unused localized strings kept in an oddly named `struct v147` block.
structured_output.verdictRationale: The off-by-one scroll index is a runtime crash risk on a core tab-tray path. The non-compiling test reference breaks the entire unit-test target. Both are mechanical to fix, and the rest of the removal is sound, so the PR should be approved once these are addressed.

architecture.overview:
The tab tray is a Redux-style store. `TabDisplayView` dispatches `TabPanelViewAction`s, `TabManagerMiddleware` performs side effects against `TabManager` and dispatches `TabPanelMiddlewareAction`s back, and `TabsPanelState.reduce` folds those into state. `TabDisplayDiffableDataSource.updateSnapshot` then renders that state into a `UICollectionView` whose layout is built by `TabsSectionManager`. Before this PR, the tab panel had two sections, an expandable inactive-tabs section (section 0) and the active-tabs section (section 1), each with its own cells, header, footer, layout manager, and middleware actions.

This PR removes the entire inactive section. The collection view now has a single `.tabs` section, the reducer no longer has a `TabPanelViewAction` branch, and `scrollToTab` always targets section 1. The changes are mostly deletions. The one behavioral edit is the scroll-index fallback in `TabsPanelState.createTabScrollBehavior`, which is where the off-by-one was introduced.
steps: Entry point: `TabDisplayView` (Views/TabDisplayView.swift) receives taps and dispatches `TabPanelViewAction`. Its inactive-tab cases, header/footer supplementary views, and delete callbacks are removed in this PR.

Middleware: `TabManagerMiddleware` handles `selectTab`, `learnMorePrivateMode`, and the rest of the view actions. The close/undo inactive-tab helpers and the `refreshInactiveTabs` path are deleted, and `getTabsDisplayModel` now builds a `TabDisplayModel` without inactive fields.

State: `TabsPanelState` loses `inactiveTabs`, `isInactiveTabsExpanded`, and `ScrollState.isInactiveTabSection`. `createTabScrollBehavior` is the one place where logic changed, and its no-selection fallback index is where the bug lives.
Rendering: `TabDisplayDiffableDataSource.updateSnapshot` now appends a single `.tabs` section, and `createLayout` always returns the tabs layout, so the section-index mapping is no longer needed.

Supporting changes: `ToastType` drops the inactive close/undo toasts, Strings move the inactive-tabs strings into an unused `v147` block, and XCUI tests update their cell identifiers from `_1_x` to `_0_x`.

findings.title: Scroll fallback index is one past the last tab, causing an out-of-bounds scroll
findings.fixPrompt: In `firefox-ios/Client/Frontend/Browser/Tabs/State/TabsPanelState.swift`, `createTabScrollBehavior` (around line 143) returns `ScrollState(toIndex: state.tabs.count, ...)` in the `.scrollToSelectedTab` no-selected-tab branch. That index is one past the last tab and will be turned into an out-of-range IndexPath in `TabDisplayView.scrollToTab`. Restore the index to the last tab, `state.tabs.count - 1`, with the existing comment kept. This matches the expectation in `TabsPanelStateTests.swift` (`testCreateTabScrollBehavior_forScrollToSelectedTab_noSelectedTab_returnsLastTab_ifTabsNotEmpty`), which asserts `tabCount - 1`. Keep the rest of the change as is.

findings.title: Unit test still references the removed refreshInactiveTabs action, so the test target won't compile
findings.fixPrompt: `firefox-ios/firefox-ios-tests/Tests/ClientTests/TabTray/TabTrayStateTests.swift` still contains `testRefreshInactiveTabsAction` (around lines 142-154), which uses `TabPanelMiddlewareActionType.refreshInactiveTabs`. This PR removed that enum case from `firefox-ios/Client/Frontend/Browser/Tabs/Action/TabPanelAction.swift`, so the ClientTests target no longer compiles. Delete the `testRefreshInactiveTabsAction` test method, since it only exercised the removed action. Then grep the test target for any other `InactiveTab` references, such as `toggleInactiveTabs`, `closeInactiveTab`, or `InactiveTabsModel`, to confirm nothing else is left behind.

findings.title: MPL license header removed from TabPanelAction.swift
findings.fixPrompt: In `firefox-ios/Client/Frontend/Browser/Tabs/Action/TabPanelAction.swift`, the Mozilla Public License header (three comment lines starting with `// This Source Code Form is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public`) was accidentally deleted in this PR. Restore those three lines at the top of the file, above `import Redux`, to match the header used in the other Swift files in `Tabs/`, such as `TabDisplayView.swift`. Make no other changes.

findings.title: Inactive-tab strings are kept as unused code in a misnamed struct
findings.fixPrompt: In `firefox-ios/Shared/Strings.swift`, the block `struct v147` (around line 8461) contains four inactive-tab localized strings that are no longer referenced by any Swift code after this PR. Either delete the block entirely if the l10n keys are no longer needed, or, if they must be retained for the localization pipeline, keep them and add a comment that says why and when they can be removed. Also check whether `TabsTrayInactiveTabsSectionTitle` (around line 7879) is still used. If not, remove it too. Match the naming and access-level conventions of the neighbouring string structs.

findings.title: Clean removal of the inactive-tab model, views, and Xcode project references
findings.body:
The deletion is thorough. Every file removed from disk has its PBXBuildFile, PBXFileReference, group child, and Sources phase entry removed from `project.pbxproj`, so the project should still resolve. The `InactiveTabsSectionManagerDelegate` conformance and the `inactiveTabsSectionManager` property are removed from `TabDisplayView`, and the layout closure collapses to the tabs-only branch. That's easier to read than the old `shouldHideInactiveTabs` gate.

The XCUI cell identifier changes (`_1_1` to `_0_1`, `_1_0` to `_0_0`) and the screen-graph removals (`ToggleInactiveTabs`, the first switch on the tabs-settings screen) are consistent with the new single-section layout.
